title: sajania monstrosa
intro: Sajania monstrosa, commonly known as the 'Devil's Claw', is a plant species in the family Pedaliaceae. The health benefits of Sajania monstrosa include its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce swelling in joints. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Sajania monstrosa include iridoid glycosides, particularly harpagoside, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
